caption:
Same tool, two different outcomes.

Try this prompt next time: "Explain what this error means, why my code causes it, and how I could have found it myself. Don't fix it yet."

Then fix it yourself. Ask for the fix only if you're still stuck.

It takes 2 extra minutes. After a month you'll notice you need AI for errors much less often.

For Best Frontend Resources visit https://allahabadi.dev created by Frontend Master

altText:
Ask AI to EXPLAIN the error before you ask it to FIX the error.

"Fix this" solves the bug once.
"Explain this" means you'll recognise it next time without help.
